lines.text: When the electricity suddenly goes out in your house, can you still safely flush your toilet?
The surprising answer depends entirely on where your water comes from.
If you live in a city connected to municipal gravity water towers, your toilet will flush normally.
Standard gravity toilets rely on mechanical siphons, requiring zero electricity inside your home.
However, if your home relies on an electric well pump or basement sewage ejector, you have exactly one flush.
Once the tank empties, it won't refill, and using it further risks backing up raw sewage.
In an extended blackout, keep buckets of water handy to manually pour flush your bowl.
